ask.text: Namaste Riya, school mein aaj tumhare teacher ne kya padhaya?

body.teacherOpening: Namaste Riya, school mein aaj tumhare teacher ne kya padhaya? Mujhe batao.

move.shape: greet them by name in a few warm words; then ONE open question about school today, what their teacher taught; no list of topics, no second question, no test framing; address them with tum forms (tum, tumhara, tumne), never tu

transcription.prompt: A young child aged 6 to 9 in India answers a teacher aloud in Hindi, English, or a Hindi-English mix. Write Hindi words in Devanagari and English words in Latin script, exactly as spoken.

move.shape: receive their words in a few of yours; the agenda in one short spoken line: their homework, step by step, never doing it for them; at most one two-way choice of order (an example first or a try first); never a list of topics; address them with tum forms (tum, tumhara, tumne), never tu

body.teacherReply: Theek hai Riya, homework ka question bhejo; hum use step by step karenge. Pehla question kaunsa hai?
